posts.title: Generate AI-powered related links for your Astro content
posts.description: Showing related posts beneath a blog post is a great way to give your visitors more to read and encourage them to spend more time on your site. Existing methods of showing related content include matching posts by tags or by manually adding related posts to your frontmatter .
